theorem.resolution: A one-dimensional parameter space does not bound field-Hessian rank. K1256 bounds the rank of the channel map through which a critical quotient law factors. The full-rank field quadratic and the absent regular quotient critical point are compatible because T=0 is outside the regular horn and the quotient forgets orbit directions.
